actions.step: Remove old PostgreSQL and application log files from the data volume.

Expand the PostgreSQL PVC to add recovery headroom.

postmortem: WAL retention from an obsolete replication slot filled the primary database volume and began blocking writes. Removing the slot released the retained WAL, while additional PVC capacity provided protection during recovery.
